loginIntro: Sign in to continue your craft and growth journey.
registerIntro: A few details to create your account. You can complete your profile in two simple steps.
accountStep: YOUR FIRST STEP · CREATE AN ACCOUNT
onboardingIntro: Tell us a little about yourself. Save your progress as you go.
humanHelp: A PERSON TO HELP YOU GET STARTED
helpIntro: Prefer a conversation? Leave your details and an admin can help you register by phone.
helpSuccessText: An admin can review your request and contact you at your preferred time. This request does not create an account.
phoneHint: Use a 10-digit Indian number or include the country code, such as +91.
passwordHint: At least 10 characters with a letter and a number; maximum 72 UTF-8 bytes.
callTimeHint: Include a time range and time zone, for example 4–6 pm IST.
contactPrivacy: Only admins can view these contact details. Do not share passwords or sensitive documents here.
unauthorized: This page is not available for your role.
unauthorizedText: Your account does not have permission to open this workspace.
pendingText: Your profile will be reviewed by an admin. Verification is pending; you cannot verify yourself. Matching and projects will arrive in a later phase.
artisanCompleteText: Your business profile is saved. You can edit it from your workspace. Growth requests and matching will arrive in a later phase.
draftSaved: Progress saved. You can return later to continue.
editReviewNote: Saving changes to a verified profile or its skills will require a new admin review.
languagesHint: Separate languages with commas, for example Hindi, English.
onlineHint: Tell us where you sell or share your work online. Write “None yet” if you are just starting.
skillsHint: Select at least one skill and choose your current proficiency.
invalid: Please check this field and enter a valid value.
verifiedText: Your profile has been verified by an admin. Your skills are ready for the next phase of the platform.
rejectedText: Your profile needs changes. Read the admin’s notes, update your profile and submit it for another review.
laterWorkflows: Your profile is ready. Growth requests, matching and project work are planned for later phases.
noRecordsText: New records will appear here. Try changing the filter.
completeBeforeReview: This student must complete onboarding before a review decision can be made.
rejectionHint: Explain what needs to change. At least 3 characters are required.
assistanceAdminIntro: Contact details are private to admins. Updating a request assigns it to your admin account; it does not create an artisan account.
confirmStatus: Please confirm this change. The updated status will be saved to the database.
workspaceIntro: Your profile, verification and next steps in one place.
logoutHint: Logging out ends all current sessions for this account.
sessionNotice: Account access and onboarding are active. Partnership workflows are coming in later phases.
registrationNote: Choose a role to create your account. Admin registration is not public.

errors.INVALID_CREDENTIALS: Email, phone or password is incorrect.
errors.CONTACT_EXISTS: An account already uses these contact details. Try logging in.
errors.UNAUTHENTICATED: Your session has ended. Please log in again.
errors.FORBIDDEN: Your role does not have permission for this action.
errors.NETWORK_ERROR: We could not reach the server. Check your connection and try again. Nothing has been confirmed.
errors.REQUEST_FAILED: We could not complete this request. Please try again.
errors.VALIDATION_ERROR: Please check your information and try again.
errors.INVALID_SKILLS: Choose skills from the available list.
errors.SKILLS_REQUIRED: Select at least one skill before submitting.
errors.STALE_RECORD: This record changed. Close this dialog, refresh the page and review the latest version.
errors.NOT_FOUND: This record could not be found.
errors.RATE_LIMITED: Too many attempts. Please wait 15 minutes and try again.
errors.ACCOUNT_SUSPENDED: This account is suspended and cannot be verified.

onboarding.student: Let your skills tell your story.
